item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm glad you think my voice in this is great, but the effect is actually quite easy to replicate yourself:

  1. Listen to some 50s propaganda or instructional videos until you feel confident enough in replicating the tone/accent
  2. Record whatever it is you need
  3. (Optional) You may need to drop the pitch on your recording one or two steps unless you have the sexiest voice alive
  4. Turn on your equalizer and drop anything above 4000 Hz and below 150 Hz
  5. Keep dropping the higher or lower number (EG, drop 3000 Hz, then 175 Hz, then 2500 Hz, etc.) until you're satisfied with the sound

If you want to sound REALLY authentic you can also twist a cheap water bottle or equivalent to make that characteristic popping sound you sometimes here in old recordings (from the needle hitting the record), although I didn't do that myself.

I use Audacity for my sound editing, it's free and I'd recommend it unless you're doing something really high-end like music editing.

Follow these words and you should have your very own Cold War era propaganda/news film/presidential address.
